text: Pre-read for tomorrow's architecture review: I think we should NOT let skills declare arbitrary network egress in their manifest. If a skill can phone home, curation can't promise safety. Want to argue this before we lock the schema.
Agreed, and it ties to review load. Every egress permission is a thing a human reviewer has to reason about.
+1. I can draft a manifest schema that makes egress an explicit, reviewed capability rather than a free-text field.
